meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能按BIDS标准处理神经科学数据：整理目录结构、查询文件、验证合规性、将DICOM转成BIDS、编写元数据文件。
howto.when: 当用户要处理BIDS数据集（如整理目录结构、查询文件、验证合规性等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我用PyBIDS查询这个数据集里有哪些被试和任务
say.note: 会返回被试和任务列表。

say.text: 验证这个数据集是否符合BIDS规范
把这个DICOM文件夹转换成BIDS格式
say.note: 会调用转换工具生成BIDS目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle BIDS datasets for neuroscience and biomedical data: organizing directory structures, querying files by subject/task, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, and writing metadata sidecars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to work with BIDS datasets—e.g., organizing directory structures, querying files, or validating compliance.

say_en.text: Use PyBIDS to query which subjects and tasks are in this dataset.
Validate this dataset against the BIDS specification.
say_en.note: Runs the bids-validator and reports issues.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS format.
